title: Shder instance uniform buffer size error on Nvidia and Intel graphics cards
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in: v4.5.1.stable.mono.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono - Tested and reproduced on two different machines with Windows 10, Ubuntu 24, and PopOS. Both machines had Intel integrated graphics cards and Nvidia discrete graphics cards. PopOS specs: Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960M (nvidia; 580.119.02) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-6300HQ CPU @ 2.30GHz (4 threads) - 7.61 GiB memory.

### Issue description

An error is thrown upon exceeding 256 CanvasItems with materials using shaders with instance uniforms.  This was tested and confirmed to occur with CanvasItems created through the scene tree or RenderingServer. Undoing or attempting to delete a CanvasItem that has exceeded the number throws an additional error.

This issue can be reproduced on Intel integrated and Nvidia discrete graphics cards, but not on the AMD Ryzen 5 5600 G integrated graphics card that we tested. 

It seems that an arbitrarily low buffer size is allocated for instance variables. This is not in accordance to hardware power, since the error occurs on an RTX 2070S, but not an integrated AMD card.

Output:
```
--- Debug adapter server started on port 6006 ---
--- GDScript language server started on port 6005 ---
Duplicate Node(s)
Duplicate Node(s)
  ERROR: Too many instances using shader instance variables. Consider increasing rendering/limits/global_shader_variables/buffer_size in the Project Settings. Maximum items supported by this hardware is: 4096.
Scene Undo: Duplicate Node(s)
Scene Undo: Duplicate Node(s)
  ERROR: drivers/gles3/storage/material_storage.cpp:2038 - Condition "global_shader_uniforms.instance_buffer_pos.has(p_instance)" is true. Returning: -1
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the reproduction project.
2. Duplicate one of the Sprite2D nodes, bringing the total number of sprite nodes to 256. Nothing will happen in the output log.
3. Duplicate a node again, bringing the number of sprite nodes to 257. Now you will notice errors in the output. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Only tested on the mono version, but there's no C# in the reproduction project:
[instance-uniform-error-demo.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24614856/instance-uniform-error-demo.zip)
